title: Talmadge grows up: school, Air Force and work
summary: He finished school in North Carolina, joined the Air Force, married twice and works in oil exploration in San Francisco.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: So then this is what we did. We just stopped him, and he never did go back to it. He never did go back to it. And of course after that he decided -- he went to -- he finished high school in North Carolina, Palmer Memorial Institute in North Carolina was a marvelous school for black children. Then he finished there and he came -- when he came out of there did he go to Palmer? Not Palmer. Pierce. Pierce Junior High. He went out to Pierce Junior High.
Junior College. He went to Pierce Junior College a couple of years, and then he decided he wanted
to go into the service. He volunteered to go into the Air Force, and that's what he did.

So he stayed his full time in the Air Force, four years. And when he came out of that then he went into the aircraft industry and he worked there, and later he did marry and that marriage was not a success. It lasted about 10 months. And he was still sort of lost as to what he really wanted to do. He just didn't seem to -- he first thought he was going to take up technical writing. This is something definitely, he said, "That's what I want to do. That's what I want to do." And he went into that and he didn't stick with that, and several other things. But now he's in the exploration bit, doing an exploration thing for Standard Oil. That's what he's into now, and he likes it very, very much.
He also now is into computing. However, he's finished a course in computing, but he hasn't gone into it yet.
San Francisco. And he just married again, oh, about last May, about 8 months ago. He just married again. And I don't have any grandchildren yet, but I'm hoping.
